title: potentilla acaulis subsp. arenaria
intro: Potentilla acaulis subsp. arenaria, commonly known as rock potentilla or sand cinquefoil, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the rose family (Rosaceae). This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Potentilla acaulis subsp. arenaria are thought to be attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, tannins, and phenolic acids, which may help to reduce inflammation, soothe skin irritations, and protect against oxidative stress. Further research is needed to fully understand the bioactive constituents and therapeutic potential of this plant, but it has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions.
